title: 26th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/26/3/2025).
First reading of the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Hoarafushi MP Dr Anara Naeem to amend Law No. 30/2024 (Fiscal Responsibility Act).
First reading of the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhudhoo MP Mohamed Shahid to amend Law No. 9/2009 (Act on Protection and Privileges for Former Presidents).
Preliminary debate on the Land Transport Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Kurendhoo MP Mohamed Shamin Habeeb.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend Law No. 2/99 (Maldives Tourism Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Hithadhoo North MP Mohamed Sinan.
Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem noting discrimination between citizens by the judicial branch, to ascertain the views of members of Parliament.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend Law No. 30/2024 (Fiscal Responsibility Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Hoarafushi MP Dr Anara Naeem.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend Law No. 9/2009 (Act on Protection and Privileges for Former Presidents), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhudhoo MP Mohamed Shahid.
Report of the seven-member select committee on the bill to amend Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act).
Report of the seven-member select committee on the bill to amend Law No. 10/2010 (Local Council Elections Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting gave first reading to Fiscal Responsibility and former-presidents' privileges amendments, opened debate on the Land Transport Bill, a Tourism Act amendment and a resolution on court discrimination, and took up select committee reports on the Decentralisation and Local Council Elections Act amendments.
